raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

The Beam cookbook only offered the `docker run` form of each command (`--gpus all`, `--shm-size 32g`, port and cache mounts, `--ipc=host`, the `lmsysorg/sglang:beam` image). Other cookbooks, such as MiniMax-M3.1, let readers switch between a Python and a Docker command, with Python selected first. Beam now does the same.

## Modifications

- `docs/src/snippets/configs/reflection/beam-1.0.jsx`: remove `runModes: ["docker"]`. Without it the engine shows the Python / Docker toggle with Python first, as for the other cookbooks. The `dockerImages` map stays for the Docker output.
- `docs/cookbook/autoregressive/Reflection/Beam-1_0.mdx`: "generate the Docker command" now reads "generate the launch command", and the "Install SGLang" box explains the toggle: the Python output is the bare `sglang serve` command to run inside a container from the `lmsysorg/sglang:beam` image, and the Docker output wraps the same command in `docker run`. The `docker pull` line is unchanged.

The flags of every recipe are unchanged.

## Accuracy Tests

Not affected: documentation only.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not affected: documentation only.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

<!-- pr-states:start -->
---
### CI States

Latest PR Test (Base): <!-- slot:pr-test:start -->:white_check_mark: [Run #39912257240](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/39912257240)<!-- slot:pr-test:end -->
Latest PR Test (Extra): <!-- slot:pr-test-extra:start -->:x: [Run #39912257212](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/39912257212)<!-- slot:pr-test-extra:end -->
Latest PR Test (AMD ROCm 10): <!-- slot:pr-test-amd:start -->:heavy_minus_sign: **No AMD PR run found for this commit**.<!-- slot:pr-test-amd:end -->
<!-- pr-states:end -->
